issues.description: The initializer parameter labels/order for Course differ between the template/ problem statement and the solution. The problem statement and the template show an initializer with signature init(name: String, instructor: String, ratings: [Int]) (the hint uses Course(name: ..., instructor: ..., ratings: ...)), while the solution defines init(instructor: String, name: String, ratings: [Int]). This mismatch in parameter ordering/labels is likely to confuse students when comparing the solution to the instructions and template.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor parameter labels and order consistent across artifacts. Either change the solution initializer to init(name: String, instructor: String, ratings: [Int]) to match the problem hint and template, or update the problem statement and template to use init(instructor: String, name: String, ratings: [Int]). Preferably use init(name: String, instructor: String, ratings: [Int]) to match the example in the problem statement.
